summary: Report observed source price differences independently from equivalence and filter each room plan against the requested budget and meals.
reason: Unknown eligibility must not hide published alternatives; one matching plan must not expose unrelated plans as filter matches, and filtered counts must not alter source continuation.
validated_outcome: Deterministic and live comparisons expose monetary observations without unverified savings; budget/meal filters remove nonmatching plans, while unfiltered empty plan pages retain room identity and native pagination.
